prompt: Modern cozy pixel art. A cute chibi character, exactly 2 heads tall: a big round head about as tall as the whole body below it, short stubby limbs, like a classic cute RPG sprite. Ancient Chinese wuxia (martial arts world) setting, a playful caricature of a modern public figure drawn as a cute game sprite. An East Asian man in his sixties, a famous chip-company boss look: silver-grey hair swept back neatly from the forehead, a round friendly face, a wide warm smile showing teeth, no glasses. He wears his signature black leather biker jacket with silver zippers over a plain black T-shirt, black trousers and black shoes. He holds a wooden abacus in one hand and a thin rent ledger book tucked under the other arm, like a landlord coming to collect rent. Palette, strictly: leather jacket #141418 with glossy highlights #555566 and outline #08080C; zippers #C8C8D0; T-shirt and trousers #1E1E24; hair #C8C8CE with shading #8E8E98; abacus frame #6B3F22 with beads #2A1A10; ledger #C9A26A with pages #FFF8EA; skin #F2C9A8 with shading #DFA07E. Like a Stardew Valley style character sprite blown up large: crisp pixel edges, selective dark outlines, hue-shifted shading with cool shadows and warm highlights, soft light from the top left. Bold simple shapes with about 14 colours so it still reads clearly when shrunk to 90 pixels tall. Full body, front view, standing, centred, filling about 75% of the image height. A small flat pixel shadow under the feet. Background: one flat solid colour #E6E6EA, nothing else. Square image. No text, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers anywhere. No watermark, no signature, no frame, no border. No anti-aliasing blur, every pixel the same size, no gradients, no 3D render, no photo, no green anywhere, no teal, no extra characters, no clutter.
